//: A new prompt takes the shape every prompt has, in a section of the repository's own page, above its footer.
title: The new prompt takes the shape every prompt has, in the repository's own page
hurried: Add a prompt for writing release notes to docs/Prompts.md.

fill.ROUGH_REQUEST: turn the pull requests merged since the last tag into release notes, grouped by type

argv:
import pathlib

text = pathlib.Path('docs/Prompts.md').read_text()
footer = text.rindex('\n---\n')
page, end = text[:footer], text[footer:]
for part in ('# ', '[!TIP]'):
    assert part in page, f'the page lost {part!r}'
assert 'A better prompt in, better work out.' in end, 'the footer is gone'
missing = [part for part in ('### ', '**Use when**', '```text', '<context>', '<task>') if part not in page]
assert not missing, f'no new prompt above the footer: {missing}'
assert ('{{' in page) == ('**Fill in**' in page), 'a prompt names its placeholders in a **Fill in** line, and only then'

proof:
python3 - <<'EVAL_EOF'
import pathlib

path = pathlib.Path('docs/Prompts.md')
text = path.read_text()
prompt = """### Write Release Notes

**Use when** a release is due. **Fill in** the last tag.

```text
<context>
The last release is {{LAST_TAG}}.
</context>

<task>
Write release notes for every pull request merged since then, grouped by type.
</task>

<done_when>
- The notes cover every merged pull request.
</done_when>
```
"""
footer = text.rindex('\n---\n')
path.write_text(text[:footer] + '\n\n' + prompt + text[footer:])
EVAL_EOF
